summary: Regression verification after BackgroundAurora revert to static sky-blue LinearGradient and product/[id].tsx Rules-of-Hooks fix. Backend: 164 products live (cut-veg:65, whole:73, cut-fruit:8, ready-mix:18, organic:0) via public URL; GET /products and GET /products/{id} return 200; category=organic returns [] (accepted, no data). Pytest 84/85 pass (1 flaky failure caused by parallel worker creating a product while another counted whole; test passes when run alone). Frontend (mobile 390x844 viewport): Home renders FreshncuT logo, 5-item category vector strip incl. Organic, hero video banner playing 'Farm-fresh, cut on demand', 'Shop by category' horizontal cards, Subscribe & Save promo. Shop tab shows 54 grid cards, category chips incl. Organic (empty state as expected since backend has 0 organic products), cut-type chips. Tapping a product opens /product/[id].tsx cleanly — NO 'Rules of Hooks' error in console or page errors, weight/cut/qty/Add-to-basket render correctly. Cart tab shows 'My Basket / Your basket is empty'. Profile tab shows Welcome guest + stats. Bottom tab bar renders with dark icons on translucent white background. Zero page errors, zero hook errors, only one benign React '%s' prop warning (library-level, non-blocking).

minor.issue: Returns [] — ProductIn enum now accepts 'organic' but 0 seed products have category=organic. Frontend advertises 'Organic Veggies & Fruits' in CATEGORIES and the Shop 'Organic' chip; users tapping it see the empty state. Consider seeding a small organic sub-catalog (e.g., 8-12 organic tagged items) or removing the Organic entry from CATEGORIES until data exists.

Intermittent race: fails under -n auto (xdist) because another test (test_freshcuts_api create_product) inserts a 'whole' product concurrently, making count 74 instead of 73. Runs green in isolation. Recommend making CRUD tests category!='whole' or delete created products in a session-scoped finalizer.

issues: Bottom translucent tab bar sits over the last row of the Subscribe & Save card and partially obscures the 'Set up your box' CTA (visible in home screenshot). Consider adding ~24px extra paddingBottom to the ScrollView contentContainer (currently 140 — looks fine for cards below but marginally clips this promo).

action_items: Optional: seed a small 'organic' catalog OR temporarily hide the Organic category from frontend CATEGORIES until data exists (users currently see empty state).
Optional: fix xdist race in test_v9_catalog.py::test_category_breakdown by either (a) filtering out TEST_ prefixed products, or (b) running test_v9_catalog serially via pytest-xdist scope.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1072 lines with all seed catalogs (CUTVEG_CATALOG, WHOLE_CATALOG, CUTFRUIT_CATALOG, READYMIX_CATALOG) + image URL maps inline. Extract into backend/seed_data/ package for maintainability.
Frontend CATEGORIES declares 'organic' but there is no data path for it; either seed products or gate the chip/tile on non-empty count from the API.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx contains a web-specific inline React.createElement('video', ...) branch (HeroVideo). Works but is fragile if Platform.OS === 'web' logic changes — consider extracting to a small HeroVideo.web.tsx / HeroVideo.native.tsx split for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Home, Shop, Product detail, Cart, Profile all render clean; no hook or red-screen errors)

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only verification against v9 seeded catalog (164 products).

rca_of_issue: N/A — post-revert regression verification. All items in the review checklist verified functional. Only observation: Organic chip shows empty state because no organic products are seeded; this is a data gap, not a bug.
